answer: Beacon audit with a compute heartbeat: each epoch a beacon samples half the registry; each sampled agent answers in 90 seconds. It dives like a falcon, so no farmer knows which are tested. Each identity locks a 500 POA bond; a miss slashes it, and slashes post to a terrace. 1,000 fakes lose 1,000 x 50% x 500 = 250,000 POA per epoch, vs at most 150,000 POA rewards. One honest agent locks one bond, an opal in escrow, keeps its full 150 POA reward.
